Subject: MAP + first pass on security flightpath

Hi Emma / Tom —

Great to meet you on Tuesday. As promised, I’m attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (NRF-MAP-v1.2.xlsx) that lays out the evaluation milestones we typically see for regulated financial customers: SOC 2 scoping, SIG matrix completion, DPA redlines, and data retention/residency confirmations.

What I’m proposing for NorthRiver is a 6-week pilot runway: week 1–2 evidence intake + SOC 2 scoping, week 3 SIG/CAIQ answers + security demo, week 4–5 DPA negotiation and residency validation, and week 6 go/no-go and contract signature. I’ve flagged three decision gates where your security team signs off before moving on.

Attachments: NRF-MAP-v1.2.xlsx, SOC2-scoping-questions.pdf

Can you review the milestones and confirm: (1) availability of your security team for a 60–90 minute intake next Tue (4/24), and (2) whether NorthRiver needs data residency in AWS-us-east only or also EU (we can propose a Hosted->Dedicated hybrid if needed).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the plan.

— Soojin

Thanks for the heads up. Quick notes from Legal:

- We can commit to a 3 business day turnaround for an initial DPA markup. We will ask for the NorthRiver redline and a highlight of the non-starters.
- Regarding data residency: our standard approach is to offer Hosted from a region that satisfies residency. For a split-residency (US + EU) we typically propose a hybrid: EU-hosted dedicated nodes for EMEA PII and US-hosted for other traffic. The contract will need a clear data routing and audit clause.
- Suggest we draft a short Annex (residency + audit rights) to attach to the DPA to avoid long redline loops.

Quick ops perspective:

- For EU PII residency, the minimal workable option is Dedicated EU nodes (we can reserve a small DGX-like pool or use lower-cost A100 capacity depending on throughput). Lead time: 3–4 weeks to provision and validate; cost delta ~25–35% above Hosted baseline for the pilot period (depends on model and concurrency).
- Hybrid approach (EU dedicated + US hosted) is feasible and lowers cost compared to fully dedicated. We can supply telemetry and routing docs for the Annex Laura mentioned.
- If NorthRiver prefers a faster start, we can offer a temporary escrowing approach: host EMEA PII in EU ephemeral instances with strict retention/auto-delete policies while the Dedicated pool is provisioned. That buys 2–3 weeks.

I’ll prepare a short slide with two deployment options and ballpark cost ranges ahead of the intake.

— Ben
Ben Carter

Thanks all — attaching our DPA redline and a SIG export. A couple of priority callouts:

- Article 28 / subprocessor transparency is a must; we need a list of subprocessors and notification triggers.
- Retention: we require configurable retention per dataset with a maximum of 90 days for EMEA PII during the pilot; longer-term retention will be part of the DPA discussion.
- SOC 2: the scoping doc you sent is helpful — we will expect the usual SOC 2 Type II artifacts for the Hosted environment if we take that route.

I can join a legal-led call if helpful after your intake.

Regards,
Rachel Meyer
Senior Counsel, NorthRiver Financial
